scope: Independent SD pin and primary-source electrical review; not manufacturing approval

connector.detection: Official catalog p3: separate contacts A/B, open without card, closed with inserted card. KiCad numbers9/10 are a library convention, not vendor numbering. A/B switch is nonpolar.
connector.limits: Official 2D drawing direct download403; browser screenshot tool returned only textual refs. Exact A->10/B->9 physical-letter mapping not independently visually confirmed. Do not treat this review as final mechanical/footprint approval.

switch.details: See tmux1511-control-review.json for voltage boundaries, IOX/SEL leakage derivation and limitations. Two switches powered from SD_3V3; six SEL pins toSD_IO_EN; two unused SEL hardGND and corresponding S/D NC. Local C701/C705100n onSD_3V3.

resolved_issues: Rejected Nexperia74CBTLV3245PW because its VSW absVCC+0.5 can be exceeded during unequal rail collapse. No TI evidence used for Nexperia part.
R223 external defaultLOW pull changed100k->10k: 6*2uA TMUX +1uA IOX =13uA, producing0.13V nominal, belowVILmax0.45V; do not count typical6Mohm internal pulls. Merged control sheet now uses10k.
TOUCH R215 same issue with4SEL:9uA leakage budget ->0.09V nominal10k; merged control+TOUCH notes use10k.
unclosed: Hirose official catalog confirms A/B normally open, closed with card; standardKiCad9/10 maps nonpolar pair. Exact official mechanical drawing/letter orientation not visually confirmed because official download403; footprint remains candidate.
TMUX VDD1.5..1.65 V with3.3V signal is outside recommended operation range but belowabs6V; no all-rampHi-Z claim. Startup/shutdown/leakage need board measurements.
TCA9539 IIL specification requires validVCC; zero-VCC or brownout behavior is not proved by10k calculation.
SD20MHz target,4-bit signal integrity, cardpower pulses, ESD robustness and hot-remove/unmount handling require bench validation.
budget_notes: Each10k select pull consumes330uA at3.3V while enabled.
TwoTMUX supply currents allocate140uA max in their stated table conditions, excluding loading.
Inserted-card detect with upstream100k consumes about33uA even whenSDpower isoff.
